An open-source player for a world of music.\nYours to explore. Yours to make your own.

Spotube is built by people, not a subscription business. If it becomes part of your everyday life, a little support helps us give it the care it deserves.\n\nThank you for making room for independent software.

Start with a catalog plugin to find songs and playlists. Choose an audio plugin to play them. Lyrics and listening history are optional. Discover a plugin below, review its permissions, install it, then select it here.

Your music. Your sources. Your rules.
A free, open-source music player built by a community that simply loves music.
Built with passion. Kept alive by you.
Spotube is 100% free, libre, and open source — no ads, no subscriptions, no tracking. Every feature exists because people like you chose to help keep the code flowing.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for believing in open music.
